Interface TTLL.ColorTheme

Enclosing interface:
TTLL
public static sealed interface TTLL.ColorTheme
ANSI color theme, the colors used when TTLL.ColorMode decides to color. The built in themes are the constants of this interface; others are made with builder(String). A theme put in the ServiceRegistry as a ColorTheme under its name can be chosen by name with the theme property.

    static final TTLL.ColorTheme
    DARCULA
    IntelliJ Darcula's colors in 24 bit color: blue time, gray thread and key values, orange logger name, and level bold red, yellow, or green (error, warn, info) with debug and trace gray.
    static final TTLL.ColorTheme
    ONE_DARK
    Atom One Dark's colors in 24 bit color, so they show the same in any terminal that supports it: cyan time, gray thread and key values, magenta logger name, and level bold red, yellow, or blue (error, warn, info) with debug and trace gray.
    static final TTLL.ColorTheme
    RAINBOWGUM
    The Rainbow Gum colors, the same as the pattern encoder's default: cyan time, faint thread and key values, level highlighted (error and warn bold red, info bold blue) and magenta logger name.
    static final TTLL.ColorTheme
    SPRING
    Spring Boot's console colors: faint time and thread, level colored by severity (error red, warn yellow, the rest green) and cyan logger name.
